问题修复
- `up` 现在会自动抓取 dsh web 的启动 URL:dsh web ≥ 0.1.2-rc 用启动时打印的一次性 token 鉴权,插件从 unit journal 里取出该 URL 并改写成本地隧道端口,直接打印带 token 的地址(`auth:` 行);`up --open` 也打开带 token 的 URL
- 抓取失败时退化为提示 `logs <host>` 查看

其他变更
- README 双语新增 token 鉴权相关排障说明

English

Bug Fixes
- `up` now surfaces the dsh web launch URL: since dsh web 0.1.2-rc gates its UI behind a one-time token printed at startup, the plugin fetches the unit journal and prints the token URL rewritten to the local tunnel port (`auth:` line); `up --open` opens that URL as well
- Falls back to pointing at `logs <host>` when the journal cannot supply it

Chores
- READMEs document the new token flow
